name: tree-mapper
description: Generate a complete Markdown snapshot of any folder in your VS Code workspace — including a full directory tree and every file's source code.

treemapper.maxFileSizeKB.description: Files larger than this (in KB) are excluded from the snapshot even if checked. Default: 2048 KB (2 MB). The count of skipped files appears in the snapshot header.

treemapper.keepLastSnapshots.description: Number of recent snapshots to keep in the .tree/ folder. Oldest are deleted automatically after each run. Default: 10.

treemapper.defaultIgnorePatterns.description: Your own extra glob patterns to unchecked by default in the file picker, ON TOP OF the built-in secrets/credentials list in src/ignorePatterns.js (baked into the extension and can't be edited here — see the extension's README for what it covers). Patterns follow .gitignore syntax (via the 'ignore' package) — a leading '!' re-includes a previously-ignored pattern. Example: ["*.local.json", "scratch/"].
